verdict.rationale: A data-training policy or opt-out is a fair privacy question for a hosted email API, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack addresses whether customer email data is used for AI model training or how to opt out. The SOC 2 report, pod isolation and BYOC mentions are adjacent security and privacy controls, not a training opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
